Synthetic Client 0 is the subject of this synthetic customer story.
Synthetic Route and Synthetic Ledger are available offerings.
Synthetic Route enables this function: Automatically route incoming support tickets.
Staff manually sorted support tickets, delaying responses.
Industry: Manufacturing.
Location: United States.
Ticket operations processing time fell by 40 percent.

Synthetic Client 1 is the subject of this synthetic customer story.
Synthetic Route and Synthetic Ledger are available offerings.
Synthetic Route enables this function: Assign new service requests without manual sorting.
Manual support-request triage delayed replies.
Industry: Industrial manufacturing.
Location: USA.
Ticket operations errors were eliminated, lowering operational risk.
